name: Yukimaru
source:
A classmate of Kotarou's. A well known flirt around school with a good-looking face, extremely sleazy when it comes to women. He seems to be unhappy about Hinata and Tsubasa not being romantically interested in him.

[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2020/03/03/tm/]Official Website[/url]]
